_comment: The values the active theme cannot reach. Everything a React component renders reads semantic tokens and follows the theme by itself; these do not, because they are consumed outside React: an HTML <meta> the browser paints its chrome with, a webfont URL, a generated manifest, and a social card rendered by a node script. One theme swap edits this file and the import in __root.tsx. Values must match the corresponding tokens in src/theme/wtuTheme.ts.

manifest.name: WhichToUse — find the best AI tool for the job
manifest.description: SaaS, open source and agent skills across 25 areas of work, with the limits of each written down.

_iconNote: Icon tiles are white. The mark's own three colours sit at 5.31 / 2.63 / 2.67 on it — the last two are low for text but this is a logotype, and they are balanced with each other, which is what makes the three letters read as one object.
_fontNote: Two families, two jobs. Inter is the interface: dense rows, tabular figures, gets out of the way. Bricolage Grotesque is the wordmark and nothing else — it has the character a logo wants and would be exhausting at 12px. Adding it here also adds it to the theme's --font-wordmark token; the two must agree. The app itself no longer sets the wordmark as type — the topbar renders the drawn lockup, public/wordmark-116.webp — so the only thing still asking for this family is the social card in scripts/gen-icons.mjs. Drop it from this URL and the card loses its logo.
_markNote: The mark's colours, not the interface's. They are baked into resources/brand/wtu-logo.svg, which every icon is rendered from; the two move together or neither does. Deliberately independent of the theme: the logo should not change colour because the product did. Note that the topbar wordmark beside the mark is a separate drawn lockup on a different palette — blue and coral, no green — and does not read these. Its blue is not one of the mark's: it is the interface primary, #4F46E5, applied by scripts/crop-wordmark.mjs, so the primary and the wordmark move together.
